horoscope: Instead of worrying about what everyone else thinks, pay attention to what you actually need today. The Moon in Taurus may make you take a closer look at yourself and your choices. Exercise or playing a sport could help you feel better. At work, be proud of what you have achieved instead of waiting for others to praise you. Be honest and clear in your relationships, too.
love: Due to the effect of Saturn, you want some changes in your relationship, but your partner’s behaviour may pull you back. Don’t be sad about it. Our expert astrologers advise you to be patient and start making changes in communication.
finance: Venus may bring some good opportunities for financial gains today. New business plans could prove profitable, while those in jobs may find a chance to earn extra income. However, a major purchase could put some pressure on your budget. Astrotalk astrologers advise you to keep your spending under control, even if your income increases.
career: You will feel confident about your work today and won't need others to keep praising or encouraging you. You know how much effort you put in and what you are capable of. Our astrologers suggest holding on to that confidence and taking your responsibilities seriously.
health: Today, exercising with some goals inspires you to do more and makes you feel excited. Make some time for Cycling, sports and walking. Jupiter influences you to stay positive. Our astrologer advises you to, instead of comparing yourself to others, move forward as per your capabilities.
